  \caption{\textbf{External annotation pipelines on a 13-genome prokaryote panel, and ablation of Stage 1 priors and Stage 2A enforcement across nine bacterial and archaeal reference proteomes.} Top rows compare NCBI PGAP, HMMER3/Pfam-A, InterProScan, DIAMOND transfer, metagenomic-deepFRI, and three-channel GSPA on 13 complete prokaryotic genomes under one ancestor-propagated evaluator against all GO annotations (experimental-only annotations in parentheses); their structural audit is computed at threshold $0.50$ on each pipeline's own output, and the perturbation column reports the mean number of $100$ injected cross-clade claims per genome that survive when Stage 1 and 2A refinement is applied on top of that pipeline's output (all $100$ survive the threshold alone). Configurations A1--A9 add priors cumulatively to Stage 0 pooling on \textit{E.~coli} K-12 (calibration genome), \textit{E.~coli} O157:H7, \textit{B.~subtilis} 168, \textit{P.~aeruginosa} PAO1, \textit{M.~tuberculosis} H37Rv, \textit{H.~pylori} 26695, \textit{M.~genitalium} G37, \textit{Synechocystis} sp.\ PCC 6803, and \textit{M.~jannaschii} DSM 2661; the last row gives the mean over the eight non-calibration genomes. Protein-centric CAFA $F_{\max}$ and pair-level micro $F_{\max}$ are evaluated against all GO annotations (experimental-only annotations in parentheses), alongside experimental information-content recall (coverage in parentheses). Consistency is the mean over genomes of $\max(0, 1 - 0.01V_g)$ for $V_g$ violations in genome $g$ (total $V$ in parentheses).
